notes: Background: Copperline runs a ~600 seat inbound contact center for a mid-sized fintech client base. Historically heavy on voice. Want to automate post-call summarization and QA scoring to reduce QA backlog and speed up coaching cycles.

Primary goals: 1) 90%+ QA coverage with AI-first summary + redline flags 2) Reduce average QA review time from 8m to <2m per call 3) Surface coaching highlights and suggested playback snippets for coaches

POC acceptance criteria (explicit): precision of 'escalation' flag >= 0.90 on labeled set; summary ROUGE-like vs human baseline within 10%; streaming summary latency p50 < 300ms, p95 < 900ms for 30s segments

Workload details: ingest 2k historical calls (transcripts + audio) for evaluation, real-time ingestion target for pilot: 200 concurrent agents peak, expected bursts up to 500 during promos. Typical call length 3-7 minutes.

Model & infra preferences: prefer open/instruction-tuned models that can be quantized and run on Dedicated pools. Will accept Redwood-hosted variants for quick wins but require private deployment for production due to data residency and encryption controls.

Feature asks: 1) real-time streaming post-call summary (short + long versions) 2) structured QA output (scores per rubric item) 3) automated coach highlights + clip timestamps 4) function-calling to create/update tickets and push summary to Salesforce/Workday 5) embeddings for search across transcripts

Reliability & cost constraints: must have graceful degradation - fallback to cheaper model variant under spike, and explicit routing policy by region/tier. Cost sensitivity: looking to keep incremental cost below $0.60 per handled conversation for summary+QA features.

Security notes: customer requires SSO + SCIM, encryption-at-rest with KMS, audit logs forwarded into their Splunk instance, and contract-level commitment on data residency (EU customers' data cannot cross EU).
Quote from Head of Ops: 'We need summaries we can trust for QA decisions — false positives on escalations break trust. Also need short 'coach bites' to speed up 1:1s.'
Integration touchpoints: Salesforce (case create/update), internal QA dashboard (via webhook), SFTP bucket for bulk transcript load, and optional on-prem connector for sensitive flows.

Risks called out by engineering: 1) live STT quality variability — need pre-processing and confidence propagation 2) latency under burst if KV cache misses are frequent 3) schema drift in transcripts (new agents, scripted changes) — want monitoring alerts for eval regressions

POC plan (concise): week 0-1 ingest + baseline eval; week 2 deploy streaming summary in sandbox + function-call proofs; week 3 run a shadow pass on 20% traffic; week 4 measure metrics and decision point.
